title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to easily check who created an environment, company and record and when
summary: Tracking who created environments, companies, and records in Business Central can be done through audit fields built into every table, the page inspection feature, change logs, telemetry, and field monitoring. These methods help administrators and users verify creation details and audit data modifications.
key_points: System audit fields (SystemCreatedAt, SystemCreatedBy, SystemModifiedAt, SystemModifiedBy) are included in every Business Central table since 2020 release wave 2
Page inspection feature allows viewing audit fields to check who created a company and when
Change log tracks direct modifications to specified tables and fields but cannot monitor system tables like Company
Field monitoring and Azure Application Insights telemetry provide advanced tracking of field changes and create detailed reports
Environment creation logs are available in the Business Central admin center Operations section

quotes.text: Every table in Business Central includes the following four system fields, which can be used for auditing records
quotes.why_it_matters: These built-in audit fields are the foundation for tracking who created and modified records without custom development

quotes.text: the companies automatically created when the environment is created, such as My Company, do not show the SystemCreatedBy
quotes.why_it_matters: This limitation is important to know when investigating who created default companies during environment setup

quotes.text: You can set up Business Central to send field monitoring activity to an Application Insights resource in Microsoft Azure
quotes.why_it_matters: Advanced monitoring integrations allow comprehensive audit trails and custom reporting on all data changes
